summary: Official Bangladesh DLRS map-search and land-zoning services were inspected. Current hierarchy requests reached the Sylhet district layer and identified Golapganj's national cadastral workflow context, but the anonymous survey-to-upazila request returned an empty list and the linked GIS WMS host returned 503. No safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response was verified; no GeoJSON sample is retained.

searchQueries.query: Golapganj Bangladesh official cadastral map land records parcel GIS
searchQueries.result: Found official DLRS map search, official Mouza-map purchase portal, and official land-zoning portal; no local open vector parcel API in indexed results.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Current official DLRS map-search HTML retrieved. It loads MapSearch.js and exposes division, district, survey, upazila, mouza, sheet and plot controls.

Current JavaScript/configuration inspected. It exposes POST hierarchy routes and a parcel vector-tile pattern /tiles/parcels/{survey}/{districtCode}/{mouza}/{z}/{x}/{y}.pbf plus /meta; no public citywide catalog or CRS metadata was exposed in the script.
Returned official division list; Sylhet was identified as code 050000000.
With divid=050000000, returned Sylhet district code 050100000 and comcod 4146.
With districtid=050100000 and comcod=4146, returned one current survey entry: RS/digital survey rsnum=201901, marked ongoing.
With comcod=4146, rsno1=201901 and districtid=050100000, returned [] rather than an upazila/mouza response. No plot request was issued because no local unit identifier was available.

Official Ministry of Land national digital land-zoning page retrieved. Current main.js exposes /getAdminByCode and /getGeomByCode POST routes and states that mouza/plot maps are digitized and georeferenced.
Anonymous direct POST using the page's visible CSRF value and cookie jar was rejected; no login, token bypass, CAPTCHA or private request was attempted.
Current official land GIS WMS host was identified from the viewer JavaScript but returned 503. No WMS schema, CRS, parcel layer, identity or geometry was obtained.

Official DLRS Mouza-map purchase portal describes CS, SA, RS, BRS and BDS survey maps and a location search workflow; it is a map/document procurement service, not an anonymous parcel-vector response.

scopeLimits: A national DLRS map workflow and district hierarchy do not establish a complete Golapganj parcel inventory.
The empty survey-to-upazila response, WMS 503, CSRF page-expired response, or unavailable UI is not evidence of cadastral absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, personal, tax/account, or other unsafe fields were requested, logged or retained.
No stable parcel identity, parcel schema, CRS, geometry quality, update currency, exact-point result, or citywide completeness was verified.
No full parcel polygon is retained and no GeoJSON sample file is provided.
Packet completion is research evidence only and does not admit a runtime adapter.

uncertainty: Bangladesh's official DLRS systems clearly provide cadastral-map search/procurement workflows, but this attempt could not traverse the current anonymous service to a Golapganj mouza/plot response. The current GIS host may require a browser session or service recovery; that limitation is not evidence of citywide absence.
